notes: PG 17.6 on Windows 11, unix_socket_directories on D:, listen_addresses empty, trust auth. asyncpg 0.32 cannot use AF_UNIX on Windows: a drive-letter path is treated as a hostname (getaddrinfo fails) and a /-path raises NotImplementedError from create_unix_connection on both Proactor and Selector loops, so 200 attempts were enough. The product uses psycopg only (packages/db), asyncpg is not a dependency. Machine under load (S3, S4, gate suite).
